hypothesis: Indirect high-confidence ortholog paths within a reconciled root group can support satellite retention without inventing ortholog pairs; broader candidates may preserve missing duplication evidence.

constraints.initial_search: Retain original HMM-derived hits for this factorial. Cached replays cannot assess recovery of hits absent from the initial search.
constraints.candidate_expansion: Use unchanged satellite_v2 parameters on previously prepared CPM-specific HMM seeds.
constraints.path_support: Only existing high-confidence ortholog edges inside the same native root group. Do not add transitive pair predictions or join native root groups.
constraints.defaults: Do not change production defaults based on this development round.
constraints.baseline_integrity: Use new output directories, immutable cached inputs, and exact direct-control output checks before interpreting variants.
constraints.resources: Use the local Threadripper. Do not stop unrelated jobs. Shared-host and incremental replay times are descriptive, not isolated full-pipeline efficiency rankings.

evaluation.selection: Report the complete metric vector and nondominated configurations, not a rank based on the six-metric mean. A development candidate requires an improvement in at least one primary endpoint and no decline greater than 0.005 on any measured endpoint relative to the direct control. This is a screening tolerance, not a statistical noninferiority claim. Missing endpoints mean screening remains incomplete.
evaluation.uncertainty: Use paired family uncertainty where supported; retain conventional native VGNC/GO/EC summaries, descriptive pooled TreeFam and conditional FAS sampling limits.
evaluation.generalization: All existing datasets, including YGOB and simulations already inspected, are development-exposed. Freeze any selected method before confirmation on genuinely unexposed data.

stages: Implement opt-in membership rule and regression tests; preserve direct-policy semantics.
Run all four arms on OrthoBench with validated cached trees, record all successes and failures, and score after inference.
Run the same prespecified arms on corrected QfO and Three Kingdoms where compatible complete checkpoints exist; preserve unavailable endpoints explicitly.
Summarize every metric and exact control comparisons before selecting any development candidate.
Design a separate bounded fresh-HMM candidate-recovery experiment after this factorial; do not describe cached clustering experiments as fresh search improvements.
git: Commit and push the plan, tested implementation, and verified result milestones. Stage only experiment-owned files.
